title: Data centers may face temporary power cuts to prevent blackouts on largest US grid | TechCrunch
summary: Many data centers favor diesel generators since the fuel is widely available and can be stored on-site. PJM has come under fire in recent months for the way it has managed new generating capacity and large new users, including data centers.
